content: backtrans-good: these are much larger SMT systems, which use the same parallel data as the baseline NMTs (see § SECREF4 ) and all the English monolingual data available for the WMT 2017 shared tasks, totalling approximately 174M sentences. These systems are strong, yet relatively cheap to build.
